headline: DPSC Limited notifies NSE of Executive Director tenure cessation during Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: DPSC Limited has informed the NSE of the cessation of an Executive Director upon completion of tenure while under a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process. The notification was made under SEBI LODR Regulation 30 and signals ongoing CIRP status at the company.
detail: DPSC Limited, a listed entity on NSE, disclosed to the exchange a corporate action involving the completion of tenure of an Executive Director. The notification was filed under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, which mandates timely disclosure of material events. The concurrent reference to 'Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process' indicates the company is operating under CIRP as defined under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. During CIRP, the Insolvency Professional assumes operational control, but the board composition changes (including KMP cessation) remain material disclosures to shareholders and market participants.
